goalbuddy_receipt_v1.summary: Hands-on QA passed root and nested marquee selection, Shift-union, cross-scope Meta exact selection, 149% zoom geometry, layer-tree synchronization, locked-primary fallback, Escape clearing, clean dirty/history state, and a clean console. It uncovered one reproducible mutation bug: Meta-dragging an already selected object from the svg.js .svg_select_shape overlay bypasses the precise-selection guard and moves the object. The QA mutation was undone and clean state restored. Preferences are blocked until a bounded overlay-path fix, review, and browser recheck complete.
evidence: Root marquee selected the fully enclosed top-level group at 99% zoom.
Nested stage-padding marquee selected all three direct Circular table children without ancestors.
Meta exact toggle and Shift-union behaved correctly away from the handle overlay.
The same nested marquee worked at 149% zoom with sidebars collapsed.
Locked Optimized center point showed data-lineage-primary-fallback with no handles; unlock restored handles.
Selection-only actions kept Undo and Save disabled; console warnings/errors were empty.
Meta-drag over selected Seatify title's .svg_select_shape moved it about 30x25px and enabled Undo/Save; Undo restored the exact prior position and clean controls.
